name: Custard wa Akimoyou
original_name: カスタードはあきもよう
source:
A romance game in an elementary school setting.

After all, it is you and I'm glad to talk face-to-face every day. I lock eyes and suddenly, I feel my heart pounding a little.

The taste is sweet and gentle.

The pattern custard fall.
translation:
一款以小学为舞台的恋爱游戏。

因为是你，所以我很高兴每天都能面对面交谈。视线相交的瞬间，我的心忽然轻轻跳动。

那味道甜美而温柔。

卡仕达色的秋日景象。
